subject: income_type
statement: The calculator asks which type of income the source tax tariff is being calculated for.

anchors.quote: Für welche Einkünfte möchten Sie den Quellensteuertarif ermitteln?

subject: income_type
statement: Income type options: 'Erwerbseinkommen' (earned income) or 'Ersatzeinkünfte' (replacement income).

subject: income_type
statement: The income type question is always shown and is the first question.

anchors.quote: Für welche Einkünfte möchten Sie den Quellensteuertarif ermitteln?

subject: income_type
statement: If the income type is 'Ersatzeinkünfte', all personal and child questions are skipped and the calculator goes straight to the main-residence question (Q16).

anchors.quote: Ersatzeinkünfte skips all personal/child questions and goes straight to Q16.

subject: civil_status
statement: The calculator asks for the civil status (Zivilstand) of the person subject to source tax.

subject: civil_status
statement: Civil status has two options: 'Verheiratet oder eingetragene Partnerschaft' (married or registered partnership) and 'Ledig, Geschieden, Getrennt, Verwitwet' (single, divorced, separated, widowed).

anchors.quote: Options: Verheiratet oder eingetragene Partnerschaft | Ledig, Geschieden, Getrennt, Verwitwet

subject: civil_status
statement: Civil status is asked only when the income type is 'Erwerbseinkommen'.

subject: confession
statement: The calculator asks for the person's denomination (Konfession).

subject: confession
statement: Denomination options: 'röm.-kath., christ.-kath., evang.-ref.' (Roman Catholic, Christian Catholic, Evangelical Reformed) or 'Keine oder andere' (none or other).

anchors.quote: Options: röm.-kath., christ.-kath., evang.-ref. | Keine oder andere

subject: confession
statement: Denomination is asked only when the income type is 'Erwerbseinkommen' and civil status has been answered.

subject: confession
statement: Denomination sets the church-tax suffix of the tariff: 'Y' for röm.-kath., christ.-kath., evang.-ref.; 'N' for 'Keine oder andere'.

anchors.quote: Sets the church-tax suffix: Y = röm.-kath., christ.-kath., evang.-ref.; N = Keine oder andere

subject: spouse_employed
statement: The calculator asks whether the spouse / registered partner is gainfully employed or receives replacement income.

anchors.quote: Ist der Ehegatte / eingetragene Partner erwerbstätig oder bezieht er/sie Ersatzeinkünfte?

subject: spouse_employed
statement: Spouse employed / replacement income options: Ja | Nein.

subject: spouse_employed
statement: The spouse employment question is asked only when civil status is 'Verheiratet oder eingetragene Partnerschaft'.

anchors.quote: Ist der Ehegatte / eingetragene Partner erwerbstätig oder bezieht er/sie Ersatzeinkünfte?

subject: spouse_employed
statement: For married/registered-partnership persons: spouse employed or receiving replacement income (Ja) gives tariff letter C; otherwise (Nein) gives tariff letter B.

anchors.quote: Ja -> C tariff; Nein -> B tariff

subject: civil_status
statement: A person with civil status 'Ledig, Geschieden, Getrennt, Verwitwet' and no counting children, resident in Switzerland, gets tariff letter A (e.g. A0Y / A0N).

anchors.quote: "Q02": "Ledig, Geschieden, Getrennt, Verwitwet", "Q03": "röm.-kath., christ.-kath., evang.-ref.", "Q06": "Nein", "Q16": "Ja"} -> result Tarif: A0Y

subject: has_children
statement: For married persons, the calculator asks whether there are biological or adopted children of the person or of the spouses/partners.

anchors.quote: Leibliche oder adoptierte Kinder der Person oder der Ehegatten bzw. Partner?

subject: has_children
statement: Children question (married variant) options: Ja | Nein.

subject: has_children
statement: The married variant of the children question is shown only when civil status is 'Verheiratet oder eingetragene Partnerschaft' and the spouse employment question has been answered.

anchors.quote: Leibliche oder adoptierte Kinder der Person oder der Ehegatten bzw. Partner?

subject: has_children
statement: For non-married persons, the calculator asks whether the person has biological or adopted children.

anchors.quote: Leibliche oder adoptierte Kinder der Person?

subject: has_children
statement: Children question (single variant) options: Ja | Nein.

subject: has_children
statement: The single variant of the children question is shown only when civil status is 'Ledig, Geschieden, Getrennt, Verwitwet' and denomination has been answered.

anchors.quote: Leibliche oder adoptierte Kinder der Person?

subject: child_age_status
statement: For each child, the calculator asks whether the child is a minor or of age and in first education.

anchors.quote: Kind minderjährig oder volljährig und in Erstausbildung?

subject: child_age_status
statement: Child age status options: 'Minderjährig' | 'Volljährig und in Erstausbildung' | 'weder noch'.

anchors.quote: Options: Minderjährig | Volljährig und in Erstausbildung | weder noch

subject: child_age_status
statement: Child questions are shown only when the person has children (Q05 = Ja or Q06 = Ja), with one block per child headed 'Kind 1', 'Kind 2', ….

anchors.quote: Kind minderjährig oder volljährig und in Erstausbildung?

subject: child_age_status
statement: Answering 'weder noch' ends the child block immediately and the child does not count for the tariff.

anchors.quote: 'weder noch' ends the child block right away (child does not count).
"Q07": "weder noch", "Q16": "Ja"} -> result Tarif: B0N (Kind Ergebnis: B0)

subject: children_repeat
statement: Child questions repeat per child; 'Ein weiteres Kind erfassen' adds another child block and 'Kind löschen' removes one; each completed block shows a 'Kind Ergebnis' code.

anchors.quote: A link button 'Ein weiteres Kind erfassen' adds another child block, and each block has a 'Kind löschen' button.
Child questions repeat for each child (input names child-1__…, child-2__…).

subject: child_same_household
statement: For each child, the calculator asks whether the child lives in the same household.

anchors.quote: Wohnsitz des Kindes im selben Haushalt?

subject: child_same_household
statement: Child same household options: Ja | Nein.

subject: child_same_household
statement: The child household question is shown only when the child is 'Minderjährig' or 'Volljährig und in Erstausbildung'.

anchors.quote: Wohnsitz des Kindes im selben Haushalt?

subject: child_parental_custody
statement: For a minor child in the same household, the calculator asks about parental custody (Elterliche Sorge).

subject: child_parental_custody
statement: Parental custody options: 'Geteiltes Sorgerecht' (shared) | 'Alleiniges Sorgerecht' (sole).

subject: child_parental_custody
statement: Parental custody (shared/sole) is asked only when the child is 'Minderjährig' and lives in the same household, for both civil statuses.

anchors.quote: Elterliche Sorge Options: Geteiltes Sorgerecht | Alleiniges Sorgerecht

subject: child_common_household_other_parent
statement: The calculator asks whether there is a common household with the other parent.

anchors.quote: Gemeinsamer Haushalt mit dem anderen Elternteil?

subject: child_common_household_other_parent
statement: Common household with other parent options: Ja | Nein.

subject: child_common_household_other_parent
statement: The common-household question is shown when (child minor AND same household AND shared custody) OR (child of age in first education AND same household).

anchors.quote: Gemeinsamer Haushalt mit dem anderen Elternteil?

subject: child_alternating_custody
statement: The calculator asks whether there is alternating care (Alternierende Obhut).

subject: child_alternating_custody
statement: Alternating care options: Ja | Nein.

subject: child_alternating_custody
statement: Alternating care is asked when (child minor AND same household AND shared custody AND no common household with the other parent) OR (married AND child minor AND not same household AND Q13 shared custody = Ja) OR (single AND child minor AND not same household AND Q14 = Ja).

subject: child_main_financial_contributor
statement: The calculator asks who makes the larger financial contribution to the child's maintenance.

anchors.quote: Wer leistet den grösseren finanziellen Beitrag an den Unterhalt des Kindes?

subject: child_main_financial_contributor
statement: Larger financial contributor options: 'Quellensteuerpflichtige Person' (the person subject to source tax) | 'Anderer Elternteil' (other parent).

subject: child_main_financial_contributor
statement: The larger-contributor question is asked when alternating care = Ja, OR for single persons when the child lives in the same household and there is a common household with the other parent; for married persons a common household with the other parent ends the child block without this question.

anchors.quote: Wer leistet den grösseren finanziellen Beitrag an den Unterhalt des Kindes?

subject: child_shared_custody_not_in_household
statement: For married persons with a minor child not in the household, the calculator asks whether there is shared custody (Geteiltes Sorgerecht, Ja/Nein).

subject: child_shared_custody_not_in_household
statement: Shared custody (child not in household, married) options: Ja | Nein.

subject: child_shared_custody_not_in_household
statement: Q13 is shown only when civil status is married/registered partnership AND the child is 'Minderjährig' AND the child does not live in the same household.

subject: child_parental_care_not_in_household
statement: For single persons with a minor child not in the household, the calculator asks 'Elterliche Sorge' with Ja/Nein (whether the person has parental custody).

anchors.quote: Same title as Q09, but with Ja/Nein options (internal name child-n__parentalCare)

subject: child_parental_care_not_in_household
statement: Parental care (child not in household, single) options: Ja | Nein.

subject: child_parental_care_not_in_household
statement: Q14 is shown only when civil status is 'Ledig, Geschieden, Getrennt, Verwitwet' AND the child is 'Minderjährig' AND the child does not live in the same household.

subject: child_main_maintenance
statement: The calculator asks whether more than 50% of the child's maintenance is mainly provided (by the person).

anchors.quote: Wird zur Hauptsache (mehr als 50%) für den Kindsunterhalt aufgekommen?

subject: child_main_maintenance
statement: Main maintenance (>50%) options: Ja | Nein.

subject: child_main_maintenance
statement: Q15 is shown only when the child is 'Volljährig und in Erstausbildung' AND (child not in same household OR (same household AND no common household with the other parent)).

anchors.quote: Wird zur Hauptsache (mehr als 50%) für den Kindsunterhalt aufgekommen?

subject: main_residence_switzerland
statement: The calculator asks whether the person's main residence is in Switzerland.

subject: main_residence_switzerland
statement: Main residence in Switzerland options: Ja | Nein.

subject: main_residence_switzerland
statement: The main-residence question is shown when income type is 'Ersatzeinkünfte', or once all personal and child questions are answered (it is hidden again while a child block is unanswered).

anchors.quote: While a child block is unanswered, the residence question Q16 is hidden.

subject: residence_country
statement: The calculator asks for the state of residence (Wohnsitzstaat).

subject: residence_country
statement: State of residence options: Deutschland | Liechtenstein | Anderes Land (other country).

subject: residence_country
statement: State of residence is asked only when the main residence is not in Switzerland (Q16 = Nein).

subject: daily_return_germany
statement: The calculator asks whether the person returns daily to the main residence in Germany.

anchors.quote: Tägliche Rückkehr an den Hauptwohnsitz in Deutschland?

subject: daily_return_germany
statement: Daily return to Germany options: Ja | Nein.

subject: daily_return_germany
statement: Daily return to Germany (Q18) is asked only when income type is 'Erwerbseinkommen' and state of residence is Deutschland.

anchors.quote: Tägliche Rückkehr an den Hauptwohnsitz in Deutschland?

subject: residence_certificate
statement: The calculator asks whether a certificate of residence (Ansässigkeitsbescheinigung) has been provided.

subject: residence_certificate
statement: Certificate of residence provided options: Ja | Nein.

subject: residence_certificate
statement: The certificate of residence question is asked only when the person returns daily to Germany (Q18 = Ja for earned income, or Q24 = Ja for replacement income).

subject: cross_border_tariff
statement: If a certificate of residence is provided (Ja), the cross-border (Grenzgänger) tariff applies with letter mapping A->L, B->M, C->N, H->P, G->Q; if not (Nein), the normal tariff applies.

anchors.quote: Ja -> cross-border (Grenzgänger) tariff: A->L, B->M, C->N, H->P, G->Q; Nein -> normal tariff

subject: daily_return_reasonable
statement: The calculator asks whether a daily return would in principle be reasonable (less than 100 km driving distance).

anchors.quote: Tägliche Rückkehr grundsätzlich zumutbar (weniger als 100km Fahrdistanz)?

subject: daily_return_reasonable
statement: Daily return reasonable options: Ja | Nein.

subject: daily_return_reasonable
statement: Q20 is asked only when income type is 'Erwerbseinkommen', state of residence is Deutschland and the person does not return daily (Q18 = Nein).

anchors.quote: Tägliche Rückkehr grundsätzlich zumutbar (weniger als 100km Fahrdistanz)?

subject: daily_return_reasonable
statement: If daily return is not reasonable (Q20 = Nein), the normal tariff applies.

subject: non_return_days_60
statement: The calculator asks whether proof of more than 60 work-related non-return days in the calendar year has been provided.

anchors.quote: Nachweis von mehr als 60 beruflich bedingten Nichtrückkehrtagen im Kalenderjahr beigebracht?

subject: non_return_days_60
statement: Proof of >60 non-return days options: Ja | Nein.

subject: non_return_days_60
statement: Q21 is asked only when daily return is reasonable (Q20 = Ja).

anchors.quote: Nachweis von mehr als 60 beruflich bedingten Nichtrückkehrtagen im Kalenderjahr beigebracht?

subject: non_return_days_60
statement: Proof of more than 60 non-return days (Ja) gives the normal tariff; no proof (Nein) gives the cross-border tariff (L/M/N/P).

anchors.quote: Ja -> normal tariff; Nein -> cross-border tariff (L/M/N/P)

subject: daily_return_liechtenstein
statement: The calculator asks whether the person returns daily to the main residence in Liechtenstein.

anchors.quote: Tägliche Rückkehr an den Hauptwohnsitz in Liechtenstein?

subject: daily_return_liechtenstein
statement: Daily return to Liechtenstein options: Ja | Nein.

subject: daily_return_liechtenstein
statement: Q22 is asked only when income type is 'Erwerbseinkommen' and state of residence is Liechtenstein.

anchors.quote: Tägliche Rückkehr an den Hauptwohnsitz in Liechtenstein?

subject: daily_return_liechtenstein
statement: Daily return to Liechtenstein (Ja) results in 'Grundsätzlich keine Quellensteuerpflicht' (in principle no source tax liability), shown with 'Unter Vorbehalt des Doppelbesteuerungsabkommens'.

anchors.quote: result Grundsätzlich keine Quellensteuerpflicht / Unter Vorbehalt des Doppelbesteuerungsabkommens

subject: non_return_days_45
statement: The calculator asks whether there are more than 45 work-related non-return days in the calendar year.

anchors.quote: Mehr als 45 beruflich bedingte Nichtrückkehrtage im Kalenderjahr?

subject: non_return_days_45
statement: More than 45 non-return days options: Ja | Nein.

subject: non_return_days_45
statement: Q23 is asked only when the person does not return daily to Liechtenstein (Q22 = Nein).

anchors.quote: Mehr als 45 beruflich bedingte Nichtrückkehrtage im Kalenderjahr?

subject: non_return_days_45
statement: More than 45 non-return days (Ja) gives the normal tariff plus 'Unter Vorbehalt des Doppelbesteuerungsabkommens'; otherwise (Nein) 'Grundsätzlich keine Quellensteuerpflicht'.

anchors.quote: Ja -> normal tariff + 'Unter Vorbehalt des Doppelbesteuerungsabkommens'; Nein -> 'Grundsätzlich keine Quellensteuerpflicht'
result Tarif: C1Y / Unter Vorbehalt des Doppelbesteuerungsabkommens

subject: replacement_income_daily_return_germany
statement: For replacement income, the calculator asks whether the person returned daily to the main residence in Germany during or before receiving the replacement income.

anchors.quote: Tägliche Rückkehr an den Hauptwohnsitz in Deutschland während oder vor Bezug der Ersatzeinkünfte?

subject: replacement_income_daily_return_germany
statement: Q24 options: Ja | Nein.

subject: replacement_income_daily_return_germany
statement: Q24 is asked only when income type is 'Ersatzeinkünfte' and state of residence is Deutschland.

anchors.quote: während oder vor Bezug der Ersatzeinkünfte?

subject: replacement_income_daily_return_reasonable
statement: For replacement income, the calculator asks whether daily return was in principle reasonable during or before receiving replacement income (less than 100 km driving distance).

anchors.quote: Tägliche Rückkehr grundsätzlich zumutbar während oder vor Bezug der Ersatzeinkünfte (weniger als 100km Fahrdistanz)?

subject: replacement_income_daily_return_reasonable
statement: Q25 options: Ja | Nein.

subject: replacement_income_daily_return_reasonable
statement: Q25 is asked only when income type is 'Ersatzeinkünfte', state of residence is Deutschland and Q24 = Nein.

anchors.quote: Tägliche Rückkehr grundsätzlich zumutbar während oder vor Bezug der Ersatzeinkünfte

subject: replacement_income_non_return_days_60
statement: For replacement income, the calculator asks whether proof of more than 60 work-related non-return days in the calendar year was provided during or before receiving replacement income.

anchors.quote: Nachweis von mehr als 60 beruflich bedingten Nichtrückkehrtagen im Kalenderjahr beigebracht während oder vor Bezug der Ersatzeinkünfte?

subject: replacement_income_non_return_days_60
statement: Q26 options: Ja | Nein.

subject: replacement_income_non_return_days_60
statement: Q26 is asked only when Q25 = Ja.

anchors.quote: beigebracht während oder vor Bezug der Ersatzeinkünfte?

subject: replacement_income_daily_return_liechtenstein
statement: For replacement income, the calculator asks whether the person returned daily to the main residence in Liechtenstein during or before receiving replacement income.

anchors.quote: Tägliche Rückkehr an den Hauptwohnsitz in Liechtenstein während oder vor Bezug der Ersatzeinkünfte?

subject: replacement_income_daily_return_liechtenstein
statement: Q27 options: Ja | Nein.

subject: replacement_income_daily_return_liechtenstein
statement: Q27 is asked only when income type is 'Ersatzeinkünfte' and state of residence is Liechtenstein.

anchors.quote: Liechtenstein während oder vor Bezug der Ersatzeinkünfte?

subject: replacement_income_non_return_days_45
statement: For replacement income, the calculator asks whether there were more than 45 work-related non-return days in the calendar year during or before receiving replacement income.

anchors.quote: Mehr als 45 beruflich bedingte Nichtrückkehrtage im Kalenderjahr während oder vor Bezug der Ersatzeinkünfte?

subject: replacement_income_non_return_days_45
statement: Q28 options: Ja | Nein.

subject: replacement_income_non_return_days_45
statement: Q28 is asked only when Q27 = Nein.

anchors.quote: Mehr als 45 beruflich bedingte Nichtrückkehrtage im Kalenderjahr während oder vor Bezug der Ersatzeinkünfte?

subject: replacement_income_tariff
statement: Replacement income ('Ersatzeinkünfte') with main residence in Switzerland or in 'Anderes Land' results in tariff G.

subject: replacement_income_tariff
statement: Replacement income with residence in Germany: tariff Q when (Q24 = Ja and certificate Q19 = Ja) or (Q24 = Nein, Q25 = Ja, Q26 = Nein); otherwise tariff G.

subject: replacement_income_tariff
statement: Replacement income with residence in Liechtenstein: daily return (Q27 = Ja) or not more than 45 non-return days (Q28 = Nein) gives 'Grundsätzlich keine Quellensteuerpflicht'; more than 45 non-return days (Q28 = Ja) gives tariff G with 'Unter Vorbehalt des Doppelbesteuerungsabkommens'.

anchors.quote: "Q28": "Ja"} -> result Tarif: G / Unter Vorbehalt des Doppelbesteuerungsabkommens

subject: residence_tariff
statement: Main residence in Switzerland or in 'Anderes Land' leaves the base tariff unchanged (e.g. A0N for a single person without children living in another country).

subject: cross_border_tariff
statement: Cross-border examples under earned income with residence in Germany, daily return and certificate: single no children Y -> L0Y; single with qualifying adult child -> L1N; married spouse not employed -> M0N; single with 1 or 3 H-children -> P1Y / P3N; married spouse employed with 1 child -> N1Y.

subject: child_count_tariff
statement: The tariff digit equals the number of children whose 'Kind Ergebnis' digit is 1 (e.g. three qualifying children of a married person with employed spouse -> C3Y).

anchors.quote: The final tariff's digit equals the number of children whose 'Kind Ergebnis' digit is 1.
result Tarif: H1N (Kind Ergebnis: H1; Kind Ergebnis: A0)

subject: single_parent_tariff_h
statement: For a single (non-married) person, any child counted with H gives an H tariff overall (e.g. A1 + H1 -> H2N). A child is counted with H when it lives in the household and the person has sole custody or is the main financial contributor.

anchors.quote: For a single person, any child counted with H gives an H tariff (e.g. A1 + H1 -> H2N).
A child is counted with H when it lives in the household and the person has sole custody or is the main financial contributor.
result Tarif: H2N (Kind Ergebnis: A1; Kind Ergebnis: H1)

subject: child_count_tariff
statement: A minor child in the same household with sole custody counts as a child (married: B1/C1; single: H1).

anchors.quote: "Q09": "Alleiniges Sorgerecht", "Q16": "Ja"} -> result Tarif: C1Y (Kind Ergebnis: C1)
"Q09": "Alleiniges Sorgerecht", "Q16": "Ja"} -> result Tarif: H1Y (Kind Ergebnis: H1)

subject: child_count_tariff
statement: Married person, minor child in same household, shared custody: common household with the other parent counts the child (C1Y); no common household counts the child only if... observed: alternating care with other parent as main contributor -> 0 (C0Y), no alternating care -> 0 (C0Y).

subject: child_count_tariff
statement: Married person, minor child not in household: shared custody + alternating care + person is main contributor counts the child (B1N); no shared custody does not count it (B0N).

anchors.quote: "Q13": "Ja", "Q11": "Ja", "Q12": "Quellensteuerpflichtige Person", "Q16": "Ja"} -> result Tarif: B1N (Kind Ergebnis: B1)

subject: child_count_tariff
statement: Married person, adult child in first education: in same household with common household with other parent counts (B1N); not in household and not mainly maintained (Q15 = Nein) does not count (B0N).

subject: child_count_tariff
statement: Single person, minor child in household with shared custody: common household with other parent and other parent main contributor -> A0N (not counted); no common household and no alternating care -> H1N.

anchors.quote: "Q10": "Ja", "Q12": "Anderer Elternteil", "Q16": "Ja"} -> result Tarif: A0N (Kind Ergebnis: A0)

subject: child_count_tariff
statement: Single person, minor child not in household: parental care Ja + alternating care + person main contributor -> H1N; parental care Nein -> A0N.

anchors.quote: "Q14": "Ja", "Q11": "Ja", "Q12": "Quellensteuerpflichtige Person", "Q16": "Ja"} -> result Tarif: H1N (Kind Ergebnis: H1)

subject: child_count_tariff
statement: Single person, adult child in first education mainly maintained (Q15 = Ja): not in household -> A1N; in household without common household with other parent -> H1N.

subject: residence_tariff
statement: Earned income, residence in Germany: cross-border code applies with daily return + certificate, or without daily return when return is reasonable and no proof of >60 non-return days; every other Germany combination gives the base tariff.

anchors.quote: DE with daily return and an Ansässigkeitsbescheinigung, or DE without daily return, return reasonable and no proof of more than 60 non-return days -> cross-border code (A->L, B->M, C->N, H->P, G->Q). Every other DE combination -> base tariff.

subject: result_display
statement: Until all required answers are given, the result box shows that information is still missing; a reset button starts a new determination.

anchors.quote: Result box 'Ergebnis' shows 'Es fehlen noch Angaben um die Tarifbestimmung abzuschliessen.' until complete; reset button 'Neue Tarifbestimmung ermitteln'.

subject: calculator_controls
statement: Every control in the calculator is a radio button; there are no dropdowns, free-text or date fields.

anchors.quote: Every control is a radio button. There are no dropdowns, free-text fields or date fields

subject: calculator_purpose
statement: The calculator determines the source tax tariff from employee data; the tariffs shown are not legally binding.

anchors.quote: Der Tarifrechner dient der Ermittlung des Quellensteuertarifs.
Die ausgewiesenen Tarife sind nicht rechtsverbindlich.

subject: calculator_scope
statement: Cases not covered by the calculator: fees to artists, athletes and speakers; board fees paid to persons resident abroad; hardship cases; pensions and capital benefits from pension plans.

anchors.quote: 'Gagen an Künstler, Sportler und Referenten', 'Verwaltungsratshonorare, welche an Personen mit Wohnsitz im Ausland bezahlt werden', 'Härtefälle', 'Renten und Kapitalleistungen aus Vorsorge'

subject: residence_tariff
statement: The residence/cross-border block was explored exhaustively only for the married + Y + 1 child path and for Ersatzeinkünfte; for A/B/H tariffs it was only spot-checked.

anchors.quote: This block was explored exhaustively under the married + Y + 1 child (C1Y / C0Y) path and for Ersatzeinkünfte. For A/B/H it was spot-checked only

subject: calculator_coverage
statement: The full cross-product of child paths × residence paths × confession × civil status was not enumerated.

anchors.quote: The full cross-product of child paths × residence paths × confession × civil status was not enumerated (combinatorial).

subject: calculator_coverage
statement: Not tested: more than 3 children (upper limit unknown), whether 'Kind löschen' recomputes correctly, and tariff D or other special tariffs.

anchors.quote: Not tested: more than 3 children (the upper limit of 'Ein weiteres Kind erfassen' is unknown); whether 'Kind löschen' recomputes correctly; tariff D or other special tariffs (none appeared in any path).

subject: calculator_examples
statement: A hidden 'Beispiele' area shows tags H3N and P3N, which were not explored as inputs.

anchors.quote: A visually hidden 'Beispiele' area shows the tags H3N and P3N. These were not clicked as inputs.
